mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC
subject: CC-WP-03 strict typed-IR frontend blocker classification
hypothesis: The pending WP03 red run is explained by a strict LALR ambiguity already present in the exact V7 grammar before typed-IR lowering.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The red run reflects a typed-IR regression, transport failure, or a single isolated OR conflict rather than a structural V7 grammar ambiguity.

result.strict_first_observed_error: GrammarError: Shift/Reduce conflict for terminal REQUIRES. [strict-mode] * <dotted_relation : qid DOT_REL>
result.causal_interpretation: The optional primary in dotted_relation makes the parser choose between reducing a bare dotted relation and shifting a token that can begin the optional RHS. Five word operators are also admitted as ident/qid, and LBRACE can begin a set primary while also serving as a following cycle-block opener. The ambiguity exists before typed-IR lowering.

functional_falsifiers.expected_intent_under_bare_relation_plus: bare Needle.owns followed by requires operator and X
functional_falsifiers.meaning: Lark's default shift resolution is observably harmful for an otherwise structurally intended bare-dotted-relation plus word-operator sequence.
When the dotted relation has an explicit RHS, the same word operator is unambiguous.
Bare dotted relation itself is admitted, confirming that optionality is intentional in V7 and participates in the conflict.

out_of_box_experiment.name: PARSER_CONFLICT_EXCISION_TOMOGRAPHY
out_of_box_experiment.purpose: Treat the grammar as a lesionable mechanism: excise one ambiguity dimension at a time and count the remaining parser-state conflicts instead of immediately proposing a new grammar version.

rows.interpretation: Keyword dual-role explains five of six conflicts but not the block/set ambiguity.
Removing optionality eliminates the structural LALR conflict family; this is a falsifier, not an authorized semantic change.
Either side of the optionality split is structurally conflict-free; the ambiguity is specifically caused by admitting both under one LALR state.

supported_points: Default LALR resolves Shift/Reduce conflicts as shift.
debug=True surfaces Shift/Reduce conflicts as warnings.
strict=True raises on Shift/Reduce or regex collisions.
interegular is required for strict regex-collision checking; its absence does not create the measured Shift/Reduce conflict family.

concurrent_evidence_fusion.joint_interpretation: V18 whole-dotted-token tokenization removes a lookahead mechanism but retains the deeper bare-atom versus operator/identifier ambiguity. V7 tomography independently localizes the broader conflict family and adds the LBRACE block/set branch.

architecture_effect.decision: Do not classify the pending WP03 failure as typed-IR regression. Preserve V7 as strict-contract-blocked evidence. Keep V17 production selection unchanged. Any future repair must separately resolve word-operator/identifier role ambiguity and bare-dotted-relation/block-set ambiguity, then pass exact-byte strict + full-corpus + semantic-hash differential validation.
architecture_effect.rollback: No code or grammar change was made; rollback is not required.
